digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today produced clear stabilization decisions, while the main launch and integration threads still need controlled follow-through tomorrow. Microsoft 365 was available and grounded the decisions and calendar preview.

items.label: Resolve the Denver voicemail blocker and reset go-live criteria
items.detail: Production tests still create voicemail records without usable audio playback. Jean confirmed that no target date can be set until the voicemail issue is solved, so carry forward the escalation, root-cause owner, next test, and revised acceptance criteria.

items.label: Stabilize Attorney Review after today's launch
items.detail: The new Attorney Review process is live. Use the scheduled check-ins to confirm the 15-minute response path, capture open issues, assign fixes, and keep attorney and manager escalation working as designed.

items.label: Close the CM CoE prioritization follow-through
items.detail: Today's alignment set the stabilization lens: compliance, outside-counsel, and truly business-blocking work comes first. Jessica still needs to identify any operational blockers, Mar will update the portfolio and metrics after that response, and Jill will brief directors tomorrow.

items.label: Set the Salesforce banner path and repair the Grievances display issue
items.detail: Confirm the short-term Do Not Call guidance, Product ownership for the broader banner inventory, and a repair timeline for the Grievances banner that hides the Matter Plan and Documents tabs.

items.label: Confirm ownership of the Salesforce integration security review
items.detail: Verify that a named owner is checking Litify, Amazon Connect, Revenue Cloud, and other integrations for supported authentication and documenting the response path for frozen or reauthentication-required accounts.

items.label: Clarify CLIP ownership and decide Tuesday coverage
items.detail: Tomorrow's 10:30 AM CLIP touchpoint conflicts with the Jhara 1:1 and Amazon Connect standup. Choose coverage and secure written handoffs before the meetings begin.

items.label: Restore or retire the disabled Power Automate flow
items.detail: Microsoft reported that the flow was disabled after repeated trigger problems kept it from running for 14 days. Identify the affected business process, decide whether the flow is still needed, and route the fix or retirement to the right owner.

items.label: CM CoE work will follow the stabilization lens
items.detail: Compliance and outside-counsel work takes priority. Improvements and automations are low priority unless delaying them would prevent a team from operating, and existing task-set updates will move through the compliance project instead of separate CoE tickets.

items.label: Amazon Connect will not receive a firm target date yet
items.detail: Jean shared that the date remains unsettled until the voicemail issue is resolved; the current Q4 placement is not a committed launch date.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Resolve the three-way coverage conflict
items.detail: CLIP, the Jhara 1:1, and Amazon Connect all start at 10:30 AM. Decide attendance and written handoffs before the morning begins.

items.label: 11:00 AM - EPMO slides followed by CM CoE/Product
items.detail: The slide-prep block runs directly into the 11:30 AM CM CoE/Product touchpoint, where today's stabilization priorities should carry forward.

items.label: Noon - Protect focus time before leadership reviews
items.detail: Blocked space runs from noon to 1:30 PM, followed by the EPMO TL Weekly Catch Up at 2:00 PM and the Nicolas 1:1 at 3:30 PM.
